title: Manage Lakewatch with the Databricks CLI (Beta)
body: You can now manage Lakewatch from the command line with the `lakewatch` command group in the Databricks CLI. Use it to create and manage datasources, parsers, and detection rules, and to update per-catalog Lakewatch configuration. The command group requires Databricks CLI version 1.25.0 or above, and the parser commands require version 1.27.0 or above. See [`lakewatch` command group](/aws/en/dev-tools/cli/reference/lakewatch-commands).
